scope: All seventeen current AG-MO lessons were audited; the identified mathematical proof omissions and source-evidence defects were corrected without reducing statements, examples or solved exercises.
proof_rule: Every used result requires a full proof in the lesson or in a completed prerequisite programme lesson read beforehand. Free external citations never replace a proof.
source_rule: Only freely accessible mathematical sources; zero paywalled citations, including historical credit. Paid books can serve only as private coverage and generality checklists.
